_comment: assets/icons/icon-manifest.json — describes every icon asset in this folder: which file backs which purpose, and which symbol inside sprite.svg is its vector counterpart. Referenced by js/core/pwa.js's PWA_CACHE_FILES precache list and by site.webmanifest.

brand.name: ECOLE LA FONTAINE
brand.designNote: Matches the .mark brand circle already used in every dashboard's topbar (admin/accountant/teacher-dashboard.js) and the boot-loader emblem in html/partials/loaders.html.

symbols.description: Standard icon, transparent outside the circle
Fills the full viewBox with brand color for OS icon masks (circle/squircle/rounded-square)
Single-color silhouette using currentColor, for notification badges or color-inheriting contexts

raster.note: Opaque background required by iOS — no alpha channel
Transparent LF cutout on a solid white circle, for the Notification API's badge option

generatedFrom.generator: Pillow (Python), hand-authored SVG for sprite.svg to match
